parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.
> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the details of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in a specified region, including cluster IDs.

parameters.name: DBName
parameters.description: The name of the database involved in the import or export task.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
Sorts tasks in ascending or descending order based on a specified field. The value must be a JSON string. Example: `[{"Field":"CreateTime", "Type":"desc"}]`

> * `Field` specifies the field by which to sort. Valid fields: `State`, `CreateTime`, `DBName`, `ProcessID`, `UpdateTime`, `JobName`, and `ProcessRows`.
> * `Type` specifies the sort order. Valid values: `Desc` (descending) and `Asc` (ascending). The values are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of records per page. Valid values:
* **30** (default).
* **50**.
* **100**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.
> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the region IDs supported by a specified Data Warehouse Edition.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). > Set the query start time to a point in time within the last 30 days.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The status of the asynchronous import or export task to query. Valid values:
* **INIT**: The task is being initialized.
* **RUNNING**: The task is running.
* **FINISH**: The task is successful.
* **FAILED**: The task failed.
